Photo by Claudia Carter on May 05, 2026. May be an image of text that says 'Does anyone know how to get back a deactivated Instagram account? My backup was deactivated for no reason at all. It asked me to identify myself to prove it was me. (Which did) but they still haven't got back to me and it's been weeks now. My account just says 'Instagram user' and there's No option to it. already appealed it once but had no response. None of my content was flagged or against the guidelines before my account got taken down. So...'.
